title: APRAXIA - Videos
description:
Engaging and colorful educational video designed to help children with Childhood Apraxia of Speech (CAS), Auditory Processing Disorder (APD) or Hearing-Related Processing Disorders,  Cleft Palate or Other Oral Abnormalities, Weak Oral Muscles (Dysarthria),  Tongue-Tie (Ankyloglossia), Oral-Motor or Structural Issues, Selective Mutism, Cerebral Palsy, Epilepsy (Landau-Kleffner Syndrome), Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
